title: Dependency ownership, cadence, and runbook for cross-team roadmap orchestration
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a lightweight, repeatable playbook and operational cadence so roadmap-level dependencies between Eng, Design, Security, and Infra are owned, tracked, and resolved before cycle planning. This ticket covers: (1) ownership matrix and SLAs for dependency handoffs, (2) weekly dependency triage cadence and template, (3) automated signals and dashboard wiring, (4) integration points with OKR tracking and cycle plan, and (5) a short onboarding doc for PMs and leads. Goal: reduce blocked work at cycle start by 60% and enable predictable rollouts across Dedicated/Private launches.
acceptance_criteria: Ownership matrix published in Confluence listing primary + backup owners for Eng/Design/Security/Infra for each major initiative
A one-page dependency template (status, owner, risk, mitigation, SLA) is available and used in next two cycle planning sessions
Weekly dependency triage cadence established with recurring calendar invite and public notes channel
Dashboard widget in Console showing top 25 open inter-team dependencies with age, owner, and impact tags
Automated Slack alerts when a dependency breaches SLA (48h for acknowledgement, 7d for resolution) and a playbook for escalation
Retro + metrics after first cycle using the playbook demonstrating decline in blocked tickets and clearer rollouts
